# Zeyad Omran

> Personal portfolio of Zeyad Omran, a software developer at IBM focused on AI assistant interfaces, reusable UI builders, frontend performance, and human computer interaction.

The portfolio presents selected frontend contributions, experience, education, design writing, and contact information. Its theme is "Hard things, made easy to use." It also introduces two independent projects: Behind the Interface and Promptly.

The interactive figures use illustrative content. The assistant is a layout study with a scripted conversation and local form state. The assistant's preview release covers documentation help, feedback, and conversation history; its workspace forms and embedded reports were built internally and have not been released. The shared-table figure compares three separate implementations with a shared component. Local selection, column-picker, density and status settings update all three sample pages. The eight-to-three-second rendering schematic illustrates a reported field-template/parser optimization, separate from the shared-table replacement; its block sizes are illustrative and it is not a live benchmark.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://zeyadomran.com/): Introduction and an interactive clarity lens revealing a simpler view of the same sample order data.
- [AI assistant interfaces](https://zeyadomran.com/#assistant): Frontend architecture and delivery of an assistant from proof of concept to production with five partner teams, custom conversation-history components, and a workspace layout that keeps tasks beside the conversation.
- [Reusable interfaces and UI builders](https://zeyadomran.com/#systems): Shared frontend widgets, UI builder expansion, coordinated data, a TanStack Table component used across 50+ product pages, and three shared TypeScript packages.
- [Rendering performance](https://zeyadomran.com/#optimization): Parallel execution and early exit guards in a shared parsing path used across 100+ product pages, with a reported 50-row reduction from eight seconds to three.
- [About and experience](https://zeyadomran.com/#about): Background in human computer interaction, developer tooling, mentoring, IBM experience, recognition, education, and skills.
- [Projects and writing](https://zeyadomran.com/#projects): Behind the Interface, a design research library with interactive demos, and Promptly, an offline Windows app for reusable text.
- [Contact](https://zeyadomran.com/#contact): Email, resume download, and professional profiles.
- [Resume](https://zeyadomran.com/Zeyad_Omran_Resume.pdf): Downloadable resume in PDF format.
